name: Scarlet Halo
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You create a blood-red halo behind your head that grants you dark power. You detect as an evil cleric equal to your caster level if you do not already, and all of your attacks are considered evil for damage reduction purposes. Additionally, you gain a +2 enhancement bonus to your Strength and Charisma.
